title: Patients with familial partial lipodystrophy of the Dunnigan type due to a LMNA R482W mutation show muscular and cardiac abnormalities.
source_type: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
text_summary: 核纤层蛋白 A/C 基因 (LMNA) 突变引起的疾病具有高度异质性，包括神经肌肉和心脏营养不良、脂肪营养不良和早衰综合征。在这项研究中，我们对带有 LMNA R482W 杂合突变的患者的神经肌肉和心脏表型进行了表征，该突变是与 Dunnigan 型家族性部分脂肪营养不良 (FPLD) 相关的最常见的基因型。临床和组织学检查显示，一名 42 岁女性患有进行性肢带型肌营养不良症，该病自童年起就存在，与典型的青春期后 FPLD 表型相关。其中一名患者的肌肉组织学符合肌营养不良症和/或显示非特异性过量脂滴（在三种情况下）。总之，我们发现大多数受 FPLD 相关 LMNA R482W 突变影响的脂肪营养不良患者表现出肌肉和心脏异常。无论潜在的 LMNA 突变如何，FPLD 患者都应接受仔细的神经肌肉和心脏检查。

                                                                         Discussion

                                                              Diseases due to mutations in the lamin A/C gene repre-
                                                               sent a highly heterogeneous group of phenotypes. Seven
                                                                   different forms are clearly defined (EDMD, LGMD 1B,
                                                                dilated cardiomyopathy and conduction system disease,
                                                         Charcot-Marie-Tooth disorder type 2, mandibuloacral dys-
                                                                      plasia, Hutchinson-Gilford progeria, and FPLD) (7–11, 13–
                                                                    17, 19, 20), and rare isolated cases with complex or mixed
                                                       phenotypes have been recently described (18, 21–23). How-
                                                                  ever, heterozygous substitutions of lamin A/C arginine 482
                                                               invariably result in FPLD and are the cause of more than 80%
                                                                 of LMNA-linked FPLD cases. This striking genetic feature of
                                             FPLD coupled with the recent characterization of the three-
                                                         dimensional structure of the lamin A/C tail led to the in-
                                                                  teresting physiopathological hypothesis that FPLD could
                                                                    result from an altered interaction between R482-mutated,
                                                       A-type lamins and an adipocyte-specific partner, possibly
                                                             the transcriptional factor sterol regulatory element-binding
                                                              protein 1, which is involved in adipose tissue differentiation
                                                                (28–31).
                                                     The aim of our study was to determine the specific char-
                                                                        acteristics of the phenotype, particularly at the muscular and
                                                              cardiac levels, of patients bearing the FPLD-linked heterozy-
                                                     gous LMNA R482W mutation. We studied 14 subjects be-
                                                          longing to two unrelated families, 10 of them (eight adults
                                                  and two children) exhibiting this LMNA mutation.
